name: hotel-central
description: Sistema Completo de Gestão Hoteleira - Hotel Central

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('backend/node_modules/.prisma', 'node_modules/.prisma', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('backend/node_modules/@prisma/client', 'node_modules/@prisma/client', {recursive: true});" && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
